Title: Scheduler Premium tier and updates to Standard tier

Body.Content:
Check out two new updates for Azure Scheduler:
  • Scalable Standard tier. Scale up to 10 Standard units, and create up to 100 job collections (10 job collections per unit).
  • New Premium tier. Receive 10,000 job collections per month with every Premium unit.
For more information, please visit the Scheduler page. To get a comprehensive look at the pricing, visit the Scheduler Pricing Details page.
